title: Architecture proposal (A1 proposals A/B, A3 synthesis S)

sources.description: Element ID -> source proposal ID. Required when synthesized.

dependencies.description: Third-party dependencies this design adds. Present and empty means none; absent means the proposal did not say, and the dependency veto is then not evaluated.

version.description: The exact version intended; without it the veto cannot be evaluated.

data_flows.description: Every flow of data from this design to a destination. Present and empty means the design sends no data anywhere; absent means the proposal did not say, and the data-class veto is then not evaluated.

contracts_touched.description: Every frozen contract this design changes. Present and empty means it touches none; absent means the proposal did not say, and the contract veto is then not evaluated.

path.description: A contract file listed in the context manifest's contract_versions.

resolutions.description: Synthesis only: what S did with each blocking finding of the A2 critiques. A4 requires exactly one entry for every blocking finding and none for any other.

critique.description: The sealed critique that holds the finding.

finding_id.description: The finding's id in that critique.

disposition.description: resolved: S fixes it. rejected: S does not, and says why.
